meaning:
οἰκιακός (in Plut., al., -ειακός), ή, όν
(οἰκία), = οἰκεῖος
belonging to the household, one's own: Mat.10:36; opposite to οἰκοδεσπότης, Mat.10:25.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more…
